note: WR-Meta supplies the complete ultimate and is used consistently for growth and cooldowns where the guides disagree. Recheck against in-game tooltips when available.
assumptions: Single target; all aimed spells hit. Default rotation is WE, EQ, QQ, R, followed by available spells and autos.
Subject choices share their parent cooldown and mana cost. WW and WE are mutually exclusive.
Cast actions take 0.45s; projectile impact and passive detonation use 0.25s. These timing estimates are not sourced cast times.
Passive base damage interpolates linearly between the published level 1 and 15 endpoints.
QW uses the isolated-target case and interpolates its published minimum/maximum damage by missing-health fraction. The source does not specify the precise execute curve.
QE assumes one eruption and 2.5s lava exposure. R ticks once per second for 3s, then explodes; repeated ticks of one cast cannot repeatedly trigger the passive.
WW maximum shield is treated as the published total cap, not added to the initial shield. Movement, vision, skillshot misses and spatial area damage are not simulated.
